wholePhysicalScope: The named 74-point OSM roof-scale outline and the 16 holes determine connected villa extent, courtyard count and approximate eave limits. The native relation’s annex identity tag disagrees with the visible standing building and is preserved as source metadata only.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the joined low copper roofs, openings, and taller garden residence. Near views refine the timber verandas and lattice screens.
limitations: The 16 mapped openings and perimeter place the overall extent. Roof-ridge layout, section dimensions and window spacing require interpretation from partial exterior views. The approximate garden-side position and height of the central pavilion are inferred from the photograph and the heritage description.
The original 5 m GSI grade, overhang footprint, and written internal floor area describe different quantities. Roof eaves are based on map extent and the building walls are recessed.
The detached demolished annex, interiors, park paths and garden planting are outside the planned model scope.
